celebrate the Solemnity of All Saints Though this holy day often falls on a weekday it falls on a Sunday this year and takes precedence as our primary celebration In this way we rejoice this weekend with the Church Triumphant who have gained everlasting life in Heaven and who pray that we might attain the same st st Commemoration of All the Faithful Departed November 2nd Following todays celebration of the Church Triumphant we turn our prayers to the Church Suffering the Holy Souls in Purgatory We will offer three special Mass times tomorrow Monday November 2nd for the Commemoration of All the Faithful Departed as we pray for our dearly departed loved ones Masses on Monday November 2nd will be at 8:00AM Noon and 5:30PM Our 5:30PM Mass will be offered at St Joseph Catholic Cemetery Note If raining the 5:30PM cemetery Mass will be moved to the Church Call No Man Father Bulletin Insert With todays solemnity we miss hearing the Gospel reading from the Thirty first Sunday in Ordinary Time Matthew 23112 In this Gospel we would hear the Lords admonishment to call no man father This verse often raises the question of why we as Catholics call priests Father The insert in this bulletin breaks down this hyperbolic passage so we can fully grasp the powerful message our Lord is giving to us I encourage you to take a few moments this week to read the insert in full Familiar passages can take on greater depth when we consider their context and how they fit within the whole of Scripture Whether this question has puzzled you personally or come up in conversations I hope this handout helps you better understand our faith and share it with greater clarity and confidence Praying for the Faithful Departed Throughout November the Church invites us to remember those who have died and pray for their eternal rest From November 1 8 we can gain a plenary indulgence for a soul in purgatory each day by devoutly visiting a cemetery and praying for the departed On the Commemoration of All Souls November 2 this plenary indulgence may also be gained by visiting a church or oratory and praying the Our Father and the Creed for the Holy Souls in Purgatory st th nd plenary indulgence offers the complete remission of the temporal punishment due to sin To gain a plenary indulgence we must be in a state of grace be detached from all sin receive Confession and Holy Communion within about twenty days before or after the visit and pray for the Holy Fathers intentions Confession You may gain only one plenary indulgence per day I encourage you to make time to visit our parish cemetery during these days Praying for the dead is a spiritual work of mercy and a beautiful reminder that our love and care for one another do not end at death For more information on the All Souls Day Indulgence visit diocesefwsborgprayforthedead November Memorial Candles For more than ten years our parish has honored deceased loved ones with memorial candles burning throughout November Last year we had more than 150 candles burning With our renovations the statuary niches that held these candles are no longer available for use This year we will continue this remembrance through an annual Book of the Dead placed near the Bl Solanus Casey Shrine where the names of our deceased loved ones can be inscribed as we remember them in prayer throughout the whole month of
